versions.content: Types of Paragraph There are two different types of paragraphs in AUTOSAR. They differ only in the elements, which they may contain: • the overview paragraph ( LOverviewParagraph ) is used as a compact descrip- tive paragraph desc . It therefore cannot embed Identifiables which might be rendered as structure (such as Xdoc etc.). • the regular paragraph ( LParagraph ) (used as p) additionally provides elements which might be rendered as structures such as meta data of external files, docu- ment and standards.
